analysis.heat.valueTitle: The heat at this pixel: what every drawn row whose sprite covers it adds, by the sprite's ramp, weight and side - the number the colour scale's saturation point is measured in.
analysis.heat.placeTitle: The rows inside the cell under the pick (two sprite radii across), the unit the heat labels and the comparison with the view use.
analysis.heat.relative: Hotter than {percent}% of the {places} places in view: {median}× the median place, {peak}% of the hottest.
analysis.heat.relativeNegative: More negative than {percent}% of the {places} negative places in view: {median}× the median one, {peak}% of the most negative.
analysis.heat.noPlaces: No other places with heat are in view to compare with.
analysis.heat.orderTitle: Walk the stack by what each row adds, or by time
analysis.heat.jumpTitle: Open the match replay a few seconds before this row, behind whoever it is about
analysis.labels.toggleTitle: Name the hottest places in view with their heat - and, in Difference, the most negative ones too. Chosen again when the camera comes to rest.
